story: After various attacks, a large chase group forms behind six leaders. Stuyven attacks with 23 km to go, gaining a good lead, but is caught 3 km before the finish. Philipsen wins the sprint ahead of Schmid and Kooij, closing in on Pedersen in the points classification. The general classification remains unchanged.
